name: Align Weapon, Hasty
body:
School transmutation [see text]; Level cleric 2, inquisitor 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action
Components V

EFFECT

Range touch
Target weapon or 10 bundled pieces of ammunition touched
Duration 3 rounds
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless, object); Spell Resistance yes (harmless, object)

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as align weapon, except as noted above.
